Limo Party Sprinter (13 Pax)

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. The Limo Party Sprinter is a limo and a nightclub in one cabin: classic limo-style seating, plush and comfortable, for thirteen. Fiber-optic roof lights over a beautifully designed ceiling, color-changing flood and floor lights, and a high-quality subwoofer sound system all around.

About the Limo Party Sprinter (13 Pax)

A wet bar with champagne cup holders inside; ambient mood lighting on the outside for the arrival. A beautiful ride from A to Z.

Right-sized for the friend group: a wine day in the Verde Valley, a brewery crawl, a birthday in Old Town.

Seats: Classic limo-style seating, very plush

Limo Party Sprinter (13 Pax) rental in Scottsdale, Phoenix and Paradise Valley: chauffeured by the hour from $175 with a 4-hour minimum, or as a one-way airport and event transfer from $325. Seats 13.
